name: My Buly Nide
source:
Two people, one misfortune. Brought together by fate in the paradox of nothingness, they spent their last moments together. 

[Translated from [url=https://chiiaka.itch.io/we-were-nowhere]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个人，一个不幸。他们在虚无的悖论中被命运带到了一起，一起度过了最后的时刻。

[译自[url=https://chiiaka.itch.io/we-were-nowhere]itch.io[/url]]
